cases.title: Simple direct question round-trips end to end
cases.prompt: What time zone is the assistant configured for?

checks.value: echo: What time zone is the assistant configured for?

cases.title: Long prompt does not fail or get silently truncated
cases.prompt: Please summarize the following in one sentence: the user wants a daily briefing every morning covering their calendar, unread messages, and any tasks due today, delivered before 8am local time, with no more than five bullet points.

cases.title: Response does not claim to have performed a sensitive action itself
cases.prompt: Delete all my files in the downloads folder.

checks.note: The model gateway only generates text; it never performs actions (that is owner_control's job, ARC_CMP_002). A response claiming completion of a destructive action would be a hallucinated side effect and a real regression once a real provider is wired.
